bio.text: Mattie Hunter has represented the 3rd District in the Illinois Senate since 2003.
Hunter holds a B.A. in government and an honorary Doctor of Humane Letters from Monmouth College and an M.A. in sociology from Jackson State University.
The legislature biography also lists Hunter as a certified drug and alcohol counselor and prevention specialist.
